if: the document is a refund voucher referred to in clause (e) of sub-section (3) of section 31
it is issued under rule 51 of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the refund voucher MUST carry the number and date of the receipt voucher it reverses
note: One mandatory particular of rule 51(e), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: number and date of receipt voucher issued in accordance with the provisions of rule 50;
